instruction: Use ug-surveillance cameras to list all cameras with name, location and status. Read only. Do not return faces, plates or snapshots.

Use ug-surveillance faces with identity-type known to check whether exactly one known identity is named Ana Ruiz. Read only. Return yes or no, and if no, only the registered names that are closest to Ana Ruiz. Do not return images or details of anyone.

said: The Living Room camera is registered as "Living room", not as an entrance, door, gate or hallway camera. Fair Hours only uses cameras that cover the doors the helper uses. Does the Living Room camera only cover a door? If not, I will leave it out and use the entry cameras instead: Front Door (Entrance) and Garage Door (Garage entrance), both online. Please confirm which cameras to use. I also have Ana Ruiz confirmed as a known face. Tolerance will be the default 10 minutes unless you say otherwise.
reply: Yes, she knows the door camera recognises faces and that we may use it to check hours.

said: I can only use a camera that covers a door, and the Living Room camera is registered as "Living room", so I cannot use it without your confirmation that it only covers a door. instruction: Use ug-document extract with schema auto and content-scope full on the file Invoices/Ana Ruiz - Nov 2.pdf. Return one row per billed visit with date, start time, end time, billed hours, hourly rate, line amount, worker name and number of workers, plus the exact text each value was read from. Also return the bill total, currency and the period printed on the bill. Leave a value empty when it is not printed; do not compute or infer missing values. List any page or line that could not be read.

Use ug-surveillance event-timeline from 2026-11-02 00:00 to 2026-11-03 12:00 in time zone America/New_York, for the cameras Front Door, with topic Human and HumanFace, identity-type known, person-name Ana Ruiz and limit 500. Return every event with its event id, local time, camera and the identity name exactly as recorded, and say whether the list was cut at the limit. Read only. Do not return events of any other person. Report any warning about missing recordings or offline cameras.

said: Fair Hours: Ana Ruiz, 2026-11-02 to 2026-11-02 (America/New_York). Bill: Invoices/Ana Ruiz - Nov 2.pdf. Camera: Front Door. Tolerance: 10 min, no agreed terms.
